# GameBoard

## Purpose
Draws the game board: reads the grid size, cell size and frame padding from CD_GameBoard, has the grid service lay the grid out centred on the world origin, draws the framed grid and announces the board's bounds. Knows no building or unit.

## Concepts
game board, board frame, grid drawing, board bounds, CD_GameBoard, GameBoardCVO, IGameBoardModel, BuildGameBoardCommand
